description.zh:
设备的名称。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the device.  
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.  
></notice>

description.zh:
设备ID。
><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The Device ID.  
><notice> **IotId** serves as the unique identifier of a device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the **ProductKey**/**DeviceName** pair, **IotId** takes precedence.  
></notice>

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the **ID** does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
设备所属的产品**ProductKey**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.  
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.  
></notice>

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为40。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 40.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-share-task-by-device-open --iot-id y4u2weAIrpp0000WHMle1234 --iot-instance-id iot-v6400000000 --product-key a2Yw00000 --device-name device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GetShareTaskByDeviceOpen --region cn-hangzhou --IotId y4u2weAIrpp0000WHMle1234 --IotInstanceId 'iot-v6400000000' --ProductKey a2Yw00000 --DeviceName device1
